activities.title: New food-business identity — design work
activities.summary: Reviewed a reply from the food-business prospect confirming interest and asking to schedule a short kickoff call. Checked availability and compared possible kickoff times against existing client commitments. Sent two possible kickoff times and a short list of information needed before identity work begins. Created a project page for the food-business identity and copied the agreed scope notes into it.

activities.title: Reference browsing and video — purpose not observable
activities.summary: Browsed food-brand identity references and packaging systems for possible discussion during the kickoff.

activities.title: New food-business identity — reference research
activities.summary: Organized the existing food-business moodboard into broader visual territories and removed several duplicate references. Added notes comparing two visual territories, including typography, color, and packaging implications.

activities.title: New food-business identity — design work
activities.summary: Joined a short kickoff call with the food-business client and discussed audience, product positioning, competitors, and expected deliverables. Recorded kickoff notes and converted several client comments into open design questions. Updated the moodboard using several references mentioned during the kickoff conversation. Started three rough logo direction frames using different typographic structures; none was developed to presentation quality.

activities.title: Social campaign — files and delivery
activities.summary: Checked for a response from the social campaign client on the corrected story asset. Received confirmation that the corrected story asset was acceptable; no additional changes were requested. Archived the approved social campaign revision and organized the latest export files.

activities.title: Northstar portfolio case study — review
activities.summary: Reviewed the Northstar Coffee case study checklist and marked several already-completed sections for reference. Checked recent reactions to the Northstar portfolio post and opened a few profiles from people who engaged with it.

activities.title: Reference browsing and video — purpose not observable
activities.summary: Watched a short video about packaging typography and label hierarchy; its direct relevance to the current project is not observable.

activities.title: Personal lettering practice — design work
activities.summary: Experimented with two lettering treatments inspired by the packaging typography reference.

activities.title: New food-business identity — design work
activities.summary: Returned to the food-business identity file and adjusted spacing on one rough wordmark direction. Checked for any additional client response; no new message was visible. Created a local folder structure for the new identity project, separating references, working files, exports, and client materials.

key_observations: The strongest forward movement was converting a prospect into a structured project with documented discovery inputs and initial visual exploration.
priority_alignment: New brand inquiry: Initiated and materially clarified; early exploration started, but no polished concept is evidenced.
Social campaign: Latest requested correction accepted and archived; broader campaign closure not established.
Northstar portfolio: Promotion/check-in only; no substantive case-study production evidenced.
important_uncertainty: The raw events do not show whether all discovery questions were answered during or after the call.
The research and lettering sessions may have supported the new identity work, but the evidence cannot establish how necessary they were.
expected_reflection.possible_next_step: Protect the next focused block for turning the kickoff notes into a small, reviewable set of identity directions rather than expanding the reference board indefinitely.

primary_action.title: Turn the kickoff notes into reviewable directions
primary_action.reason: The new project now has enough discovery context to move from preparation into concrete concept development, while further portfolio promotion can remain secondary.
